1.en: No results found. Try different keywords or clear some filters.

3.ctx: Report or history has no data in the selected range
3.en: No data in the selected time range.

4.en: The system is busy. Please try again in a few minutes.

5.en: Connection lost. Check your network and try again.

6.en: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

7.ctx: User opens a screen outside their role
7.en: You do not have permission to access this function.

8.ctx: Opening a record that does not exist or was deleted

9.type: In red, under the text box

10.type: In red, under the text box

11.type: In red, under the text box

12.type: In red, under the text box
12.ctx: Email already used by another active profile or account
12.en: This email is already used by another account.

13.type: In red, under the text box
13.ctx: Phone number not in Vietnamese format or with an unknown carrier prefix (DBR-17, P-16)
13.en: Phone number must be 10 digits, start with 0 and use a valid Vietnamese carrier prefix.

14.type: In red, under the text box
14.ctx: Phone number already belongs to another active Person, customer or staff (DBR-22); the message never says whose number it is
14.en: This phone number already belongs to another profile.

15.type: In red, under the text box
15.ctx: Date of birth in the future
15.en: Date of birth cannot be in the future.

16.type: In red, under the text box
16.en: The start date must be on or before the end date.

17.type: In red, under the text box
17.ctx: Numeric field holds text or a value ≤ 0

18.type: In red, under the text box
18.ctx: Past date chosen where only future dates are allowed
18.en: Only dates from {earliest_date} onwards can be selected.

19.type: In red, under the text box
19.ctx: Reason or description shorter than the minimum
19.en: Be more specific, at least {n} characters.

20.type: In red, under the text box
20.ctx: Image has wrong format or is too large
20.en: Only JPG or PNG images up to {max_size} are accepted.

21.type: In red, under the text box
21.ctx: No value picked in a select field

22.ctx: Record changed by someone else before saving
22.en: This record was just updated by someone else. Reload before saving.

24.ctx: Save pressed with no change made

27.ctx: Delete button pressed on a record
27.en: Delete {object}? This action cannot be undone.

28.ctx: Leaving a form with unsaved changes
28.en: Your changes have not been saved. Leaving now will discard them.

29.ctx: Deleting a record still referenced by active records
29.en: Cannot delete: {related_object} still refers to it. Deactivate it instead.

33.ctx: Wrong credentials, account that serves only the Customer role still has attempts left
33.en: Incorrect email, phone number or password. You have {n} attempts left.

34.ctx: Wrong credentials on a staff account (no auto-lock — BR-01)
34.en: Incorrect email, phone number or password. Please check again.

35.en: Account locked for {P-18} minutes after too many failed attempts. Try again in {mm:ss}.

36.en: The lock has expired. You can sign in again.

37.ctx: Sign-in to an account that is Locked by the Admin, or Inactive because every role of its Person is Inactive (CBR-96, CBR-86)
37.en: This account cannot be used to sign in. Please contact an administrator.

38.ctx: Account created by a receptionist, password not set yet (CBR-31)
38.en: This account has no password yet. Please use Forgot password to set your password

39.type: In red, under the text box
39.en: Enter your email or phone number.

41.type: In red, under the text box
41.ctx: Password recovery, no account on that email
41.en: No account found with this email.

42.en: A code has been sent to {email}. It is valid for {P-15} minutes.

43.type: In red, under the text box
43.en: Incorrect code. Check again or press Resend code.

44.type: In red, under the text box
44.en: This code has expired. Press Resend code to get a new one.

45.en: A new verification code has been sent.

46.type: In red, under the text box
46.en: Password must be at least {n} characters.

47.type: In red, under the text box

48.type: In red, under the text box
48.ctx: New password same as current one
48.en: The new password must differ from the current one.

49.ctx: Password changed in Account Settings (UC-04, CBR-93)
49.en: Password changed. All your other sessions have been signed out.

50.ctx: Sign-up: phone has no profile, move to the details step
50.en: Phone number accepted. Please fill in your registration details.

51.ctx: Sign-up with a phone that already has an account (CBR-26)
51.en: This phone number already has an account. Please sign in or use Forgot password.

52.ctx: Sign-up with an existing profile's phone but a different email (CBR-25)
52.en: This phone number is registered with a different email ({masked_email}). Use that email, or visit the front desk to have it updated.

53.en: Your profile has no email on file, so it cannot be activated online. Please visit the front desk to add one.

54.en: Your account has been created. Please sign in.

55.en: A verification code has been sent to the new email address.

56.en: Sign-in email updated. We notified the old address and signed out your other sessions.

59.en: All other devices have been signed out.

60.ctx: Customer opens Full name / Date of birth / Check-in photo in their account (CBR-30)
60.en: This information is updated by the front desk. Please bring your ID to the counter.

61.ctx: 5 wrong codes or 5 code requests within an hour
61.en: Too many attempts. Verification for this email is locked for {P-18} minutes. Try again in {mm:ss}.

62.type: In grey, under the text box
62.ctx: Code screen shown or a wrong code entered; the current code still has 2 or more attempts left
62.en: You have {n} attempt(s) left to enter the code.

63.type: In amber, under the text box
63.ctx: Only 1 attempt left for the current code (replaces MSG62)
63.en: One more wrong entry will lock verification for this email for {P-18} minutes.

64.ctx: Code screen shown; the email can still request new codes within the current 60 minutes
64.en: You can request {n} more code(s) within 60 minutes.

65.ctx: 4 codes already requested for this email within 60 minutes; the 5th request triggers the lock (CBR-94)
65.en: No code requests left. Requesting another code will lock verification for {P-18} minutes.

66.type: In red, under the Password box
66.ctx: Sign-up, account activation, Forgot password step 3 and Change password — password longer than 64 characters or without both a letter and a digit (DBR-02)
66.en: Password must be {min}–{max} characters and contain both letters and digits.

67.type: In red, under the Full name box
67.ctx: Any form with a full name — the name contains a digit or a symbol other than space, apostrophe or hyphen (DBR-01)
67.en: Full name may contain only letters, spaces, apostrophes or hyphens.

68.type: In red, under the Code box
68.ctx: Any code screen — the code is not exactly 6 digits (DBR-03); not counted as a wrong attempt
68.en: The verification code must be exactly 6 digits.

69.type: In red, under the Date of birth box
69.ctx: Date of birth gives an age above 100 (DBR-04)
69.en: Invalid date of birth (age must not exceed {n}).

70.ctx: Resend code pressed less than 60 seconds after the previous code (CBR-94)
70.en: Please wait {n} more seconds before resending the code.

71.type: In red, under the Current password box
71.ctx: Change password — the current password is wrong (UC-04)

72.type: In red, under the Full name box
72.ctx: Full name shorter than 2 or longer than 50 characters after trimming (DBR-01)

73.ctx: Public blog: opening a post that is Inactive or does not exist (CBR-100)
73.en: This post is no longer available.

74.ctx: Select Role screen after sign-in, account serves more than one role (CBR-113)
74.en: Choose the role you want to work in.

75.ctx: Role switched from the account menu (CBR-113)

76.ctx: Staff role acting on their own customer profile (CBR-115)
76.en: You cannot perform this action on your own customer profile. Please ask another colleague.

77.ctx: Leave request after the submission cut-off (CBR-84, P-12)
77.en: Submission deadline passed. Leave on {date} had to be submitted before {P-12} on the previous day.

78.ctx: Leave request blocked by Scheduled sessions (CBR-83)
78.en: You still have {n} scheduled session(s) in this period. Reschedule, transfer or cancel them before submitting the request.

79.ctx: Approving leave would break minimum staffing (BR-14, CBR-88, CBR-90)
79.en: Cannot approve: the {shift} shift on {date} would have fewer than {min} {position}(s) on duty.

80.ctx: Leave request auto-rejected at the approval cut-off (CBR-85, P-20)
80.en: Your leave request for {date} was rejected: Approval deadline passed.

81.ctx: PT package sale without a valid membership package (CBR-59, BR-37)
81.en: {customer_name} needs a valid membership package before a PT package can be sold.

82.ctx: Customer under the minimum PT age (CBR-13, CBR-14, CBR-15, P-05)
82.en: PT services are available only to customers aged {P-05} or older.

83.ctx: Check-in refused: no valid membership package or day pass (BR-27)
83.en: Check-in refused: the customer has no valid membership package or day pass today.

84.en: This day pass has already been used.

85.type: In red, under the voucher box
85.ctx: Voucher fails a validity condition (CBR-73, CBR-74, CBR-76)

86.ctx: Voucher change while a transaction is Pending (CBR-75)
86.en: The voucher cannot be changed while a payment is in progress.

87.ctx: Closing a shift with Pending counter orders (CBR-78)
87.en: Cannot close the shift: {n} counter order(s) are still Pending.

88.ctx: Lock, demote or resign the last active Admin (BR-06, BR-07)
88.en: This is the last active Admin account. It cannot be locked, demoted or set to Resigned.

89.en: The position cannot be changed while unfinished work remains: {details}.

90.en: This PT package has already used all {P-08} swaps.

91.ctx: Session already started or no longer Scheduled (BR-70, BR-76)
91.en: This session has already started or is no longer scheduled, so it cannot be changed.

92.ctx: Target date not covered by a valid membership package (CBR-61, CBR-60)
92.en: The customer has no valid membership package on {date}. Please choose another date.

93.ctx: Staff opens a personnel field in Account Settings (CBR-108)
93.en: This information is updated by the Manager.

94.ctx: Staff opens position or account status in Account Settings (CBR-109)
94.en: Only the Admin can change this information.

95.ctx: Password reset through Forgot Password completed (UC-03, CBR-93)
95.en: Your password has been reset and all sessions have been signed out. Please sign in.

96.ctx: Deletion request sent because the customer still has a running package or PT sessions (CBR-16, BR-16)
96.en: Deletion request sent to the Manager for approval.

97.ctx: Cancelling a Paid counter order outside its shift (CBR-11)
97.en: This order can only be cancelled during the open shift that created it.

98.ctx: Paying an online order after its deadline (CBR-70)
98.en: The payment deadline has passed and the order was cancelled. Please create a new order.

99.ctx: Freeze refused: not a membership package, package expired, freeze allowance used up, or a freeze already open (BR-21, BR-23, BR-24)

100.ctx: Freeze longer than P-02 or past the days left on the package (CBR-08, DBR-13)
100.en: A freeze can last at most {P-02} month(s) and must end by {date}.

101.ctx: The profile already has a pending deletion request (CBR-16)
101.en: This profile already has a pending deletion request.

102.ctx: Admin adds a staff record for a Person who already has an active staff record (DBR-65)
102.en: This person already has an active staff record.

103.ctx: The slot was taken by someone else between display and confirmation (CBR-53, DBR-36)
103.en: This slot has just been taken. Please choose another slot.

104.ctx: PT adds a slot that overlaps an existing slot (DBR-33)
104.en: This slot overlaps an existing slot ({start}–{end}).

105.ctx: Action outside its allowed time window: attendance, rescheduling, marking absent (BR-54, BR-69, BR-70)
105.en: This action is outside the allowed time window.
